story_thesis: Nvidia used $401 million of its returns and warranty reserve in the July quarter. Its two latest filings show why the balance barely moved and which figures to watch next.
duplicate_checks: Reviewed current publishing branch and daily ledgers, editorial legacy Mag7 files, dated remote branches, content inventory, topic index, live finance catalogue, morning ABNB/HSY/TPR and other November 8 coverage. Open PRs 43/57 unrelated. NVDA and TSLA unfeatured in new series. TSLA had separate recent Cybertruck coverage. NVDA stories cover competitive position, margin and customer concentration without reconciling warranty activity.
evidence_table: Q1 10-Q: April 26 FY27, USD millions, opening 2807 + 330 additions - 189 utilisation = 2948. Q2 10-Q: July 26 FY27, 2948 + 391 - 401 = 2938; prior July additions 220. Rounded filing figures used by quarter. Utilisation increased 212m sequentially.
Quarterly results sales 81615m, 96221m and 46743m in Q1 FY27, Q2 FY27 and Q2 FY26. Additions per $100 sales: 0.4043, 0.4064, 0.4707. Hypothetical 10 basis points x 96221m = 96.221m.

10-Q combines estimated returns and warranty activity. Mainly Compute & Networking additions. No count of units serviced or product-level failure rates inferred. Q2 GAAP margin 75.0% actual, August Q3 outlook 74.0% +/- 0.5 percentage points, scenario separate.
